name: Zenodo_search_records
description: Search Zenodo for research data, publications, and datasets with exact totals and explicit page navigation. Continue with metadata.next_page while metadata.has_more is true. Returns records with title, authors, DOI, and file information.

query.description: Free text search query for Zenodo records. Use keywords to search across titles, descriptions, authors, and other metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 200.

page.description: One-based result page. Continue with metadata.next_page.

community.description: Optional community slug to filter results by specific research community (e.g., 'zenodo', 'ecfunded').

count.description: Number of records in the hits array

url.description: API endpoint URL used for the request

error.description: Error message if status is error

name: Zenodo_get_record
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific Zenodo record by its record ID. Returns comprehensive information including title, description, authors, DOI, publication date, keywords, license, file information, citations, and related identifiers. Use this to get complete metadata for a record found via search or when you have a specific Zenodo record ID or DOI. Find record IDs from Zenodo_search_records (format: integer like 1234567).

record_id.description: Zenodo record identifier (e.g., 1234567, 7654321). Find record IDs using Zenodo_search_records or from publication DOIs (DOI format: 10.5281/zenodo.1234567).

doi.description: The DOI itself, without the resolver prefix, e.g. '10.1175/2010mwr3413.1'.

relations.description: How this record relates to its siblings, under 'version' - each entry giving the index of this version, whether it is the latest, and the parent concept. The only statement of whether a newer version exists.

resource_type.description: What kind of deposit it is: 'type' (e.g. 'publication'), 'subtype' (e.g. 'article') and a human 'title'. The subtype is what separates a journal article from a preprint or a thesis.

conceptrecid.description: Zenodo's id for the record's concept - the version-independent handle that always points at the latest version, e.g. '1234566'. Citing recid pins one version; citing conceptrecid does not.

doi_url.description: Resolvable DOI URL for the record, e.g. 'https://doi.org/10.1175/2010mwr3413.1'. Note it can be a DOI minted elsewhere, not a Zenodo one, when the deposit records an externally published work.

modified.description: When the record was last changed, e.g. '2024-08-02T16:40:10.039329+00:00'. A Zenodo record is editable after publication, so this is what says whether the metadata has moved.

owners.description: The Zenodo accounts that own the record, each as {'id': ...}. Who may change it - not the same as the creators who are credited.

recid.description: Zenodo's id for this exact version of the record, e.g. '1234567'. A string, not a number.

revision.description: How many times the record has been revised, e.g. 8.

state.description: Deposit state, e.g. 'done', 'inprogress', 'error'. Anything but 'done' means the files may not be retrievable.

stats.description: Usage counts for the record: downloads, unique_downloads, views, unique_views and the version_* variants of each. The version_* figures count this one version, the plain ones the whole concept, so the two answer different questions.

submitted.description: True once the deposit has been submitted and published; false for an unpublished draft.

title.description: Record title, e.g. 'Environment and Early Evolution of the 8 May 2009 Derecho-Producing Convective System'. Present at the top level as well as inside metadata.

name: Zenodo_get_record_files
description: Get the list of files for a specific Zenodo record including file names, sizes, checksums, and download URLs. Returns detailed file metadata essential for downloading datasets, code, or supplementary materials. Each file includes direct download URL, MD5 checksum for verification, file type, and size in bytes. Use this to access the actual data files from a Zenodo record. Find record IDs from Zenodo_search_records or Zenodo_get_record.

record_id.description: Zenodo record identifier (e.g., 1234567). Find record IDs using Zenodo_search_records.

return_schema.description: List of files with download URLs.

name: Zenodo_list_licenses
description: List available licenses that can be applied to Zenodo uploads. Returns license metadata including license ID, title, URL, and description. Use this to discover available open licenses (e.g., Creative Commons, MIT, GPL) for your data uploads, or to understand the licensing terms of existing records. Essential for researchers planning to upload data or checking licensing compliance.

query.description: Optional search query to filter licenses by name or keyword (e.g., 'creative commons', 'MIT', 'GPL').

limit.description: Maximum number of licenses to return (default: 25, max: 100).

name: Zenodo_get_license
description: Get detailed information about a specific license by its license ID. Returns complete license metadata including title, URL, description, domains of applicability (content/data/software), and license status. Use this to understand the specific terms and conditions of a license before applying it to your uploads or when checking the licensing of existing records. Find license IDs using Zenodo_list_licenses (common IDs: 'cc-by-4.0', 'cc-zero', 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'GPL-3.0').

license_id.description: License identifier (e.g., 'cc-by-4.0', 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'GPL-3.0'). Find license IDs using Zenodo_list_licenses. Common IDs include Creative Commons licenses (cc-by, cc-by-sa, cc-zero), open source licenses (MIT, Apache, GPL), and others.
